spec.title: LLM Deployment Analytics $model
spec.description: The state of the deployment: 0 = healthy, 1 = partial outage, 2 = complete outage

spec.expr: litellm_deployment_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", litellm_model_name=~"$model"}
sum by (model, team, team_alias, user, user_email) (rate(litellm_spend_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Requests Rate
spec.description: Total number of requests made to the proxy server - track number of client side requests

spec.expr: sum by (route, requested_model, team, team_alias, user, user_email) (rate(litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Failed Requests (top 10)
spec.description: Total number of failed responses from proxy - the client did not get a success response from litellm proxy

spec.expr: litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}

spec.title: Models Latency
spec.description: Total latency for a models LLM API call

spec.title: Failed Fallbacks (Last 25)
spec.description: Number of failed fallback requests from primary model -> fallback model

spec.expr: litellm_deployment_failed_fallbacks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}

spec.title: Failed Fallbacks (top 10)
spec.description: Number of failed fallback requests from primary model -> fallback model

spec.expr: litellm_deployment_failed_fallbacks_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}

spec.title: Models Time To First Byte Latency
spec.description: Time to first token for a models LLM API call

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (team, team_alias) (litellm_spend_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}))
topk(10, sum by (user, user_email) (litellm_spend_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}))
topk(10, sum by (user_agent) (litellm_spend_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}))
topk(10, sum by (model) (litellm_spend_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}))

spec.title: Tokens Rate
spec.description: Rate of input/output tokens from LLM requests

spec.expr: sum by (model, team, team_alias, user, user_email) (rate(litellm_input_tokens_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (model, team, team_alias, user, user_email) (rate(litellm_output_tokens_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Failed Requests (Last 25)
spec.description: Total number of failed responses from proxy - the client did not get a success response from litellm proxy

spec.expr: litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}
